opsproc.title: Portable Oxygen Unit (non-required units inoperative or missing)

procitem.title: PROCEDURE TO BE DEVELOPED IN THE OPERATOR'S MEL

unlist.para: A procedure must be established to:

item.para: Ensure that the required distribution of the oxygen units is maintained (portable oxygen units must be evenly distributed in the cabin), and
Inform the cabin crew on the location of the operative oxygen units.
